name: bun-global-alias-install
description: To install an npm CLI under a different global name with bun: check the package's real bin name via the npm registry (curl registry/<pkg>/<ver> | bin field), 'bun install -g pkg@ver', then mv $BUN_INSTALL/bin/<real-bin> $BUN_INSTALL/bin/<alias> and probe '<alias> --version | grep -qx <ver>' plus '! command -v <real-bin>'. Verified with @os-eco/seeds-cli@0.5.15 -> sd-ref (run 01M32Q6DNMY1CXC16W7V6J4Y0D, seeds-a9e7). Note: bun install takes a directory via --cwd, not a positional dir arg.

name: nu-mixed-schema-journal-records
description: In nushell scripts that parse JSONL tables from heterogeneous writers, never do bare column access like 'get ts' on a parsed record set — foreign record shapes (missing columns) raise column_not_found and crash deterministic guards. Filter first: 'where {|r| (.ts? != null) and (.node? != null) }' and treat the filtered v1 set as the verdict domain (seeds-aa89, tracker-guard.nu develop-claims).

Local runs from agent/shell environments with both NO_COLOR and FORCE_COLOR set break the seeds differential battery: sd (bun) emits a Node warning ('NO_COLOR env is ignored due to FORCE_COLOR') on stderr, so 'stderr emptiness diverged' fails (differential_command_matrix, show_missing_id_json_flag et al.). Not a main regression.
resolution: Verify locally with: env -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR cargo nextest run ... (2026-09-22, integration pass after PRs #37-#42: 74/74 green in clean env; CI/toolchain sandbox unaffected)

name: seeds-toolchain-pin-bump-flow
description: Verified pin-bump flow (seeds-b1e9, 2026-09-23): bump = 12 pin sites (verify.nu, qualitygate.nu, ci.yml, .mise.toml, README, AGENTS.md, Dockerfile.toolchain, project-facts.md, 4 rust-style-guide docs) + fixing new-nightly clippy pedantic lints BEFORE commit (map_unwrap_or->map_or_default, assert_is_empty->assert_eq); gate with fmt --check + clippy -D warnings + nextest (RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN=<pin>, SEEDS_COMPAT_SD set) on the NEW toolchain; then gh auth token | docker login ghcr.io; just image-release (tag = HEAD sha12); fabro env pin-toolchain --from-run-images --server <server>. Keep .fabro/revisions|reviews untouched (history).

name: rootprint-fabro-log-triage
description: rootprint (~/go/bin) is the log query plane for fabro line triage: index otel-logs-v0_9 default, service_name=fabro. Useful full-text queries: "Run created from intent" (run inventory), "Workflow run failed" (real failures), plain run-id lookup (per-run activity; a no-op develop run shows only Run-created + title-gen WARN). Severity via severity_text WARN/ERROR; local time = UTC+2 vs message timestamps.

fabro CLI 0.362.0-nightly 'fabro inspect <run>' fails against mirtuell server 0.361.0-nightly with Invalid Response Payload: missing field 'label' (run spec deserialization). Evidence: 2026-09-24 run 01M39RJ902T7NPY0YB8B1JAZ4N.
resolution: Use 'fabro automations --server <url> runs <automation-id>' or 'fabro events <run>' until client/server versions align.
